name: The Long Ladakh Riding Journey
route: Leh · Nubra · Pangong · Approved extended circuit
description: An extended riding enquiry with a detailed route and rental basis to be agreed.
quoteReason: The reference is priced in USD. Ask for a currency-specific quote; no unsupported exchange-rate conversion is applied.

itinerary.title: Leh arrival
itinerary.description: Arrive and keep the day for rest; no riding is assumed.

itinerary.title: Leh rest day
itinerary.description: Retain a second gentle day and seek individual professional advice about altitude suitability.

itinerary.title: Leh orientation
itinerary.description: Complete the agreed motorcycle handover, briefing, and optional suitable orientation.

itinerary.title: Nubra route
itinerary.description: Ride only if health, roads, permits, and operator advice support the stage.

itinerary.title: Nubra village day
itinerary.description: Keep a flexible local day with rest as needed.

itinerary.title: Nubra surroundings
itinerary.description: Discuss a suitable approved excursion with the riding operator.

itinerary.title: Pangong route
itinerary.description: Continue only on a confirmed suitable route; alternative stays may be required.

itinerary.title: Extended circuit
itinerary.description: The exact highland stage must be specified by the specialist operator before booking.

itinerary.title: Approved route day
itinerary.description: Ride only the agreed stage with named support and contingency arrangements.

itinerary.title: Return towards Leh
itinerary.description: Return along the confirmed route, allowing time for disruptions.

itinerary.title: Leh buffer day
itinerary.description: Retain a contingency and rest day before departure.

itinerary.title: Leh departure
itinerary.description: Return the motorcycle and depart using the agreed transfer.

inclusions: Accommodation for the stated nights on the quoted sharing basis
Breakfast and dinner on overnight days; arrival dinner and departure breakfast
Trip-route vehicle, driver, fuel, tolls, and parking as itemised in the final quote
Transfers at the agreed starting and finishing points
Local coordination and the guided visits named in your proposal
Motorcycle model, rider/pillion basis, route fuel, mechanic, and backup support to be costed and confirmed
exclusions: Flights, trains, and travel to the trip’s starting point
Lunches unless a specific day explicitly includes one
Travel insurance, personal expenses, tips, and shopping
Single-room supplements, extra nights, and optional activities
Any tax, permit, entry ticket, or local transport charge not explicitly itemised in your final quote
Riding deposits, damage liability, and personal protective equipment unless explicitly included
group: Proposed group · size to be confirmed
